parameters.help_en:
The language of the response description. Valid values:
zh: Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh: 响应说明的语言。zh：中文；en：英文
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Keep other filter conditions consistent when querying the next page
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的记录数。查询下一页时保持其他筛选条件一致
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The current page number, starting from 1
parameters.help_zh: 当前查询页码，从 1 开始
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The scenario identifier for compatible template queries. This parameter is not required for column encryption queries. The available templates are determined by the returned list. Do not rely on this parameter to determine whether general-purpose templates are included
parameters.help_zh: 兼容的模板查询场景标识。列加密查询无需传入；可用模板以返回列表为准，不应依赖此参数决定是否包含通用模板
parameters.name: usage_scenario

parameters.help_en: A reserved feature type parameter. This parameter is not used to filter results in the current query and is not required for column encryption calls
parameters.help_zh: 保留的功能类型参数。当前查询不使用该参数过滤结果，列加密调用无需传入
parameters.name: feature_type

CurrentPage.description_en: The page number of the returned data

Items.description_en: The list of records returned by the current query
Items.description_zh: 本次查询返回的记录列表

CurrentRiskLevel.description_en: The current sensitivity level of the template

Description.description_en: The description of the classification and grading template
Description.example: 用于识别常见敏感数据

GmtCreate.description_en: The time when the template was created. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
GmtCreate.description_zh: 模板创建时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

GmtModified.description_en: The time when the template was last modified. This value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC
GmtModified.description_zh: 模板最近修改时间。自 1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC 起的 Unix 时间戳，单位为毫秒

Id.description_en: The ID of the classification and grading template

MaxCategoryLevel.description_en: The maximum category level supported by the template
MaxCategoryLevel.description_zh: 模板支持的最大分类层级

MaxRiskLevel.description_en: The maximum sensitivity level supported by the template
MaxRiskLevel.description_zh: 模板支持的最高敏感等级

Name.description_en: The name of the classification and grading template

Status.description_en:
The status of the template. Valid values:
0: disabled.
1: enabled as the primary template.
2: active template.
3: general-purpose detection model
Status.description_zh: 模板状态。0：关闭；1：启用的主模板；2：活跃模板；3：通用识别模型

SupportEdit.description_en:
Indicates whether the template can be edited. Valid values:
0: not supported.
1: supported
SupportEdit.description_zh: 是否支持编辑模板。0：不支持；1：支持

Type.description_en:
The category of the template. Valid values:
1: Alibaba template.
2: finance template.
3: energy template.
4: personal information security template.
5: travel template.
65: general-purpose template.
66: custom template.
67: template from another cloud service
Type.description_zh: 模板类别。1：阿里模板；2：金融模板；3：能源模板；4：个人信息安全模板；5：出行模板；65：通用模板；66：自定义模板；67：来自其他云产品的模板

PageSize.description_en: The number of records per page for the current query
PageSize.description_zh: 本次查询的每页记录数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which can be used to locate this API call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求标识，可用于定位本次 API 调用

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of records that match the current query scope
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合当前统计或查询范围的总数量
